content: {"phoneNote":"The radiator illustration's top pipe collides directly with the text 'dan' above it, which looks like a layout bug.","desktopNote":"The custom radiator and hot/cold pipe graphics give the page a clever, trade-specific identity with crystal-clear hierarchy.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"desktop":{"impression":5,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":5,"spacing":5,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Add top margin above the hero radiator illustration on mobile so the red pipe does not overlap the text 'dan'.","Avoid repeating the exact same callback and free-inspection promises in the hero, 'Kako poteka', and footer sections.","Connect the blue return pipe of the hero radiator directly into the horizontal pipe divider below it for a cleaner graphic flow."]}
